what: The header that floated transparent over the Hero photo with white text switches to a background-color plate with dark ink text after scrolling just 50px, and its height shrinks like 118→90px (.2s ease). Back at the very top it becomes transparent again. The ‹solid› type is a plate from the start and only the height shrinks (sub pages). The ‹pill› type becomes a plate and shrinks into a translucent pill detached from the top and sides

options.at: Scroll down this far (px) to switch to the panel, default 50 — a screen-height ratio like 100vh also works (for a first page that must scroll one hero height before becoming a panel)
options.hide: When the top edge of the tail (hide-from) rises more than this many px above the screen bottom, the header line goes transparent over --fx-dur and cannot be clicked ([data-hidden]) — Brand 500
options.hide-from: Tail selector that hide watches, default footer
options.--fx-height-solid: Height when it is a panel (set via style) — e.g. 90px
options.--fx-ink: Text color when transparent (via style), default var(--kf-on-accent)
options.--fx-ink-solid: Text color when it is a panel (via style), default var(--kf-ink)
options.look: solid: Plain from the start (subpage that begins without a photo)
options.[data-solid]: Attribute added when it becomes a panel — the CSS that sets inner logo and button sizes selects with it
options.look: pill: When it becomes a panel, it shrinks into a pill set --fx-top (default 1.25rem) from the top and --fx-inset (default 3.75rem) from the sides (--fx-radius default 99px), with background --fx-bg-solid (default 60% of the base panel) and backdrop blur --fx-blur (default 2px) — all values change together over --fx-dur. The header must be fixed · left 0 · right 0 so the side margins become its width (Brand)

from.where: shared.js .sh-head (transparent → panel on the first page, solid type on subpages)

shared.js header .hh-head (white text over the photo → white panel with ink text after 100px down, inner padding 35px → 10px 15px) — original behavior.js scrollTop >= 100 · style.css .header transition .3s

shared.js header .pc-head (1081px and up — scrolling more than 100px past the header height turns it into a pill) — original header-sm: top 1.25rem · margin-inline 3.75rem · height 80px · border-radius 99px · white 60% · backdrop blur(2px), transition all .4s ease-out

shared.js header .ac-head (first page: switches at hero height, sub-pages: after scrolling 50px, 90% background panel · 190→110px · logo appears, hides when more than 500px of the footer is visible) — original header.mv·header.hid, transition all .3s
